_readme: Cue 2T, '200 Years of Media'. Text from Ben's own timeline (B:\_powersimple\OmniScience\2020Vision\VideoTimeline.ai, 2019), word for word except three spelling fixes (Jurassic, Internet, Edward -> Eadweard kept as Ben wrote: 'Edward'). kind: media = the story (bright cards), context = the world around it (dim cards, smaller). img = a public-domain picture from Ben's 2020Vision\assets folder. The one entry not in Ben's file is the 1827 Niepce photograph: its picture is in his assets folder and the brief starts the timeline at photography; its caption is the picture's own title.
